order.why: DK8 Kleeberga (40 t in the 2018 city plan) from the S edge of bialystok-knyszynska towards the S8; largest industrial area of all candidates
DK8 -> S8 junction, seam with dk65-01 (S8 + slip roads): closes the loop S8 - Kleeberga - Szosa Knyszynska and joins C (Maczka/Kleeberga) to the S8 towards Warsaw
Kuronia (the >3.5 t transit since 2025-12, research G10) from the E edge of Dojlidy to DK19 south; second highest count of halls >= 1000 m2
Ciolkowskiego DW678 + Dywizjonu 303 at the W edge of Dojlidy (the Dojlidy route starts there); first tile of the truck route C <-> Dojlidy
DK19 Branickiego / rondo Meyera / Ciolkowskiego DW678; seams with Dojlidy (N edge) and krywlany
DK19/DK65 Andersa - Sosabowskiego - DK19 Piastowska, 26 ha industrial; truck route C <-> Dojlidy
corner tile: Andersa leaves C through it (66 m of the route) - closes C <-> Dojlidy; dense housing = highest budget risk
Ciolkowskiego / Sulika (DK65) / DK19 south, 49 ha industrial; second link to Dojlidy-Gorne
DK65 Sulika, 22 ha industrial; start of the DK65 exit east (Bobrowniki)
DK8/DK19 north of C (N edge of C); few targets, cheap, start of the north exits
DK8 north towards Augustow, 14 ha industrial; DK19 turns east here
fills the hole S of bialystok-kleeberga between Kleeberga and the centre (DW669 / DW676)
S edge of C: Al. Tysiaclecia DW675 to the station area; for trucks the centre is the 3.5 t zone of the 2018 city plan (G10)

rules.budget_class: city = largest powiat share 2061; else suburban >= 250 OSM buildings, rural fewer (built tiles: buildings.geojson)
rules.target_score: halls >= 1000 m2 + warehouses + works + 2 x fuel_hgv + 2 x truck_parking + industrial ha / 10 (WORKING_VALUE weights)
rules.teryt_powiat: largest area share of the tile in PRG powiaty (Data/Admin/powiaty_prg.geojson); every other overlapped powiat in teryt_powiat_extra (ADR 0219, tools/worldgen/powiaty.py)
